title: Reject duplicate JSON keys at every nesting level
prompt: Fix json_guard.py so parse_json_object accepts one JSON object and rejects duplicate object keys at every nesting level with DuplicateJSONKeyError. JSON-equivalent escaped keys count as duplicates. Keep standard json.loads value semantics and reject a non-object top level with ValueError. Change only json_guard.py. Do not seek or edit benchmark tests. Run any checks available inside this task repository and keep the final response under 120 words.

provenance.adaptation: A deliberately regressed, dependency-free fixture of the repository's duplicate-key JSON boundary. It is representative repository code, not a claim about a current repository bug.
